meta.title: Steel Meets Steel - 1
meta.description: Rimefrost perseveres as blades sing, slaking thirst with blood.

units.rawText: Under the barrage of shells, the Oasis we poured our hearts into crumbles into rubble.
units.displayText: Under the barrage of shells, the Oasis we poured our hearts into crumbles into rubble.

spans.text: Under the barrage of shells, the Oasis we poured our hearts into crumbles into rubble.

units.rawText: [Proceed with protocols... Extermination sequence activated.]
units.displayText: [Proceed with protocols... Extermination sequence activated.]

spans.text: [Proceed with protocols... Extermination sequence activated.]

units.rawText: ...Time to sleep.
units.displayText: ...Time to sleep.

spans.text: ...Time to sleep.

units.rawText: Sangoma makes a swift sweep with her giant scythe, accurately striking the core of the Sanctifier and disabling it.
units.displayText: Sangoma makes a swift sweep with her giant scythe, accurately striking the core of the Sanctifier and disabling it.

spans.text: Sangoma makes a swift sweep with her giant scythe, accurately striking the core of the Sanctifier and disabling it.

units.rawText: Didn't think they'd destroy the passage here too.
units.displayText: Didn't think they'd destroy the passage here too.

spans.text: Didn't think they'd destroy the passage here too.

units.rawText: There's only one passage left... <cmdr>, can you still walk?
units.displayText: There's only one passage left... {교수}, can you still walk?

spans.text: There's only one passage left...
, can you still walk?

units.rawText: I'm fine. How's your condition though, Sangoma? These wounds on you...
units.displayText: I'm fine. How's your condition though, Sangoma? These wounds on you...

spans.text: I'm fine. How's your condition though, Sangoma? These wounds on you...

units.rawText: ...Just teensy scratches. <size=28>This will be the last, nonetheless.</size>
units.displayText: ...Just teensy scratches. This will be the last, nonetheless.

spans.text: ...Just teensy scratches.
This will be the last, nonetheless.

units.rawText: After sheathing her scythe, Sangoma disappears into the shadows, surveying the area.
units.displayText: After sheathing her scythe, Sangoma disappears into the shadows, surveying the area.

spans.text: After sheathing her scythe, Sangoma disappears into the shadows, surveying the area.

units.rawText: ...There's a lot of Sanctifiers here. I don't know how they bypassed our defenses in the middle ring. It seems like things aren't going well there either.
units.displayText: ...There's a lot of Sanctifiers here. I don't know how they bypassed our defenses in the middle ring. It seems like things aren't going well there either.

spans.text: ...There's a lot of Sanctifiers here. I don't know how they bypassed our defenses in the middle ring. It seems like things aren't going well there either.

units.rawText: At least the middle ring is still holding up fine, while our time is running out.
units.displayText: At least the middle ring is still holding up fine, while our time is running out.

spans.text: At least the middle ring is still holding up fine, while our time is running out.

units.rawText: Yep... We'll have to fight our way through this one.
units.displayText: Yep... We'll have to fight our way through this one.

spans.text: Yep... We'll have to fight our way through this one.

units.rawText: At the end of the road, several Sanctifiers are wandering at the entrance of our HQ.
units.displayText: At the end of the road, several Sanctifiers are wandering at the entrance of our HQ.

spans.text: At the end of the road, several Sanctifiers are wandering at the entrance of our HQ.

units.rawText: That's a troublesome number. My handy neural system manipulation trick doesn't work here.
units.displayText: That's a troublesome number. My handy neural system manipulation trick doesn't work here.

spans.text: That's a troublesome number. My handy neural system manipulation trick doesn't work here.

units.rawText: I'll fight with you.
units.displayText: I'll fight with you.

spans.text: I'll fight with you.

units.rawText: No worries. I told you, I'll keep you safe.
units.displayText: No worries. I told you, I'll keep you safe.

spans.text: No worries. I told you, I'll keep you safe.

units.rawText: She gestures for me to hide, the purple-haired Doll lifting her scythe as she rises alone from the rubble.
units.displayText: She gestures for me to hide, the purple-haired Doll lifting her scythe as she rises alone from the rubble.

spans.text: She gestures for me to hide, the purple-haired Doll lifting her scythe as she rises alone from the rubble.

units.rawText: [Extermination sequence—]
units.displayText: [Extermination sequence—]

spans.text: [Extermination sequence—]

units.rawText: Dearie me, do Sanctifiers not have other voicelines?
units.displayText: Dearie me, do Sanctifiers not have other voicelines?

spans.text: Dearie me, do Sanctifiers not have other voicelines?

units.rawText: Like pain... for instance?
units.displayText: Like pain... for instance?

spans.text: Like pain... for instance?

units.rawText: Sangoma cleaves a Sanctifier in half before they even react.
units.displayText: Sangoma cleaves a Sanctifier in half before they even react.

spans.text: Sangoma cleaves a Sanctifier in half before they even react.

units.rawText: She grips her scythe, dashing forward to launch another attack, but the gunfire forces her back almost instantly.
units.displayText: She grips her scythe, dashing forward to launch another attack, but the gunfire forces her back almost instantly.

spans.text: She grips her scythe, dashing forward to launch another attack, but the gunfire forces her back almost instantly.

units.rawText: Hngh...!
units.displayText: Hngh...!

spans.text: Hngh...!

units.rawText: The narrow passageway turns the size of her scythe into a hindrance. With her operands nearly depleted, the purple-haired Doll has no choice but to use her scythe defensively.
units.displayText: The narrow passageway turns the size of her scythe into a hindrance. With her operands nearly depleted, the purple-haired Doll has no choice but to use her scythe defensively.

spans.text: The narrow passageway turns the size of her scythe into a hindrance. With her operands nearly depleted, the purple-haired Doll has no choice but to use her scythe defensively.

units.rawText: Sangoma!
units.displayText: Sangoma!

spans.text: Sangoma!

units.rawText: Hah... You think that could stop me?
units.displayText: Hah... You think that could stop me?

spans.text: Hah... You think that could stop me?

units.rawText: Sangoma suddenly moves her scythe to her back, ceasing her defense, and quickly dashes forward. As she moves, the bullets graze her body, and the wounds leak blood-red operands.
units.displayText: Sangoma suddenly moves her scythe to her back, ceasing her defense, and quickly dashes forward. As she moves, the bullets graze her body, and the wounds leak blood-red operands.

spans.text: Sangoma suddenly moves her scythe to her back, ceasing her defense, and quickly dashes forward. As she moves, the bullets graze her body, and the wounds leak blood-red operands.

units.rawText: Despite accumulating more wounds, she uses her almost depleted operands to acquire an advantage in speed that she gained from sheathing her scythe.
units.displayText: Despite accumulating more wounds, she uses her almost depleted operands to acquire an advantage in speed that she gained from sheathing her scythe.

spans.text: Despite accumulating more wounds, she uses her almost depleted operands to acquire an advantage in speed that she gained from sheathing her scythe.

units.rawText: She leaps nimbly, bouncing off the walls in the narrow corridor to dart left and right, rapidly closing the gap between herself and the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: She leaps nimbly, bouncing off the walls in the narrow corridor to dart left and right, rapidly closing the gap between herself and the Sanctifiers.

spans.text: She leaps nimbly, bouncing off the walls in the narrow corridor to dart left and right, rapidly closing the gap between herself and the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: This... is it!
units.displayText: This... is it!

spans.text: This... is it!

units.rawText: She grasps her scythe mid-air, and with gravity's aid, it cleaves effortlessly through their defenses and bodies, reducing them to nothing but dispersing operands.
units.displayText: She grasps her scythe mid-air, and with gravity's aid, it cleaves effortlessly through their defenses and bodies, reducing them to nothing but dispersing operands.

spans.text: She grasps her scythe mid-air, and with gravity's aid, it cleaves effortlessly through their defenses and bodies, reducing them to nothing but dispersing operands.

units.rawText: With the threats vanquished, the reaper who wields a giant scythe wavers and slowly sinks to sit against a corner.
units.displayText: With the threats vanquished, the reaper who wields a giant scythe wavers and slowly sinks to sit against a corner.

spans.text: With the threats vanquished, the reaper who wields a giant scythe wavers and slowly sinks to sit against a corner.

units.rawText: Hah... Hah... It's clear now...
units.displayText: Hah... Hah... It's clear now...

spans.text: Hah... Hah... It's clear now...

units.rawText: Sangoma! That attack was too risky. You'd been a goner instead if things went wrong!
units.displayText: Sangoma! That attack was too risky. You'd been a goner instead if things went wrong!

spans.text: Sangoma! That attack was too risky. You'd been a goner instead if things went wrong!

units.rawText: Fufufu, never thought I'd be lectured by you...
units.displayText: Fufufu, never thought I'd be lectured by you...

spans.text: Fufufu, never thought I'd be lectured by you...

units.rawText: I don't have enough operands to spare for long battles. Forgive me.
units.displayText: I don't have enough operands to spare for long battles. Forgive me.

spans.text: I don't have enough operands to spare for long battles. Forgive me.

units.rawText: She gently traces my face with her fingers, as though trying to soothe the frown etched upon it.
units.displayText: She gently traces my face with her fingers, as though trying to soothe the frown etched upon it.

spans.text: She gently traces my face with her fingers, as though trying to soothe the frown etched upon it.

units.rawText: Seeing this expression on your face makes all the wounds worth it.
units.displayText: Seeing this expression on your face makes all the wounds worth it.

spans.text: Seeing this expression on your face makes all the wounds worth it.

units.rawText: ...Let's go, the Ops Room is at the end of this corridor.
units.displayText: ...Let's go, the Ops Room is at the end of this corridor.

spans.text: ...Let's go, the Ops Room is at the end of this corridor.

units.rawText: Using her giant scythe for support, she struggles to her feet. With her weight resting on my shoulder, we make our way to the Ops Room together.
units.displayText: Using her giant scythe for support, she struggles to her feet. With her weight resting on my shoulder, we make our way to the Ops Room together.

spans.text: Using her giant scythe for support, she struggles to her feet. With her weight resting on my shoulder, we make our way to the Ops Room together.

units.rawText: The room is in shambles, its original form barely recognizable. The scent of burnt circuits lingers in the air, and lines of unreadable errors flash in red on shattered screens.
units.displayText: The room is in shambles, its original form barely recognizable. The scent of burnt circuits lingers in the air, and lines of unreadable errors flash in red on shattered screens.

spans.text: The room is in shambles, its original form barely recognizable. The scent of burnt circuits lingers in the air, and lines of unreadable errors flash in red on shattered screens.

units.rawText: I walk to the dim control panel and check the current status of the Oasis.
units.displayText: I walk to the dim control panel and check the current status of the Oasis.

spans.text: I walk to the dim control panel and check the current status of the Oasis.

units.rawText: Cough. Huff... What's the status? Is it still working?
units.displayText: Cough. Huff... What's the status? Is it still working?

spans.text: Cough. Huff... What's the status? Is it still working?

units.rawText: The core system remains operational. I'll start repairs and fortifications right away and recalibrate the defense and combat system to suit the current situation.
units.displayText: The core system remains operational. I'll start repairs and fortifications right away and recalibrate the defense and combat system to suit the current situation.

spans.text: The core system remains operational. I'll start repairs and fortifications right away and recalibrate the defense and combat system to suit the current situation.

units.rawText: As I adjust the system, I assess the Oasis' situation and prepare to take command.
units.displayText: As I adjust the system, I assess the Oasis' situation and prepare to take command.

spans.text: As I adjust the system, I assess the Oasis' situation and prepare to take command.

units.rawText: But right at this moment, the ground under my feet trembles as the new klaxons screaming at me come in with the sound of gunfire.
units.displayText: But right at this moment, the ground under my feet trembles as the new klaxons screaming at me come in with the sound of gunfire.

spans.text: But right at this moment, the ground under my feet trembles as the new klaxons screaming at me come in with the sound of gunfire.

units.rawText: Warning! High-intensity operand attack detected! Warning! High-intensity operand attack detected!
units.displayText: Warning! High-intensity operand attack detected! Warning! High-intensity operand attack detected!

spans.text: Warning! High-intensity operand attack detected! Warning! High-intensity operand attack detected!

units.rawText: <size=40>...Watch out!</size>
units.displayText: ...Watch out!

spans.text: ...Watch out!

units.rawText: Urk!
units.displayText: Urk!

spans.text: Urk!

units.rawText: Sangoma pushes me away. Before I even get to react, a heavy shell strikes upon the building directly, tearing down the ceiling in an instant.
units.displayText: Sangoma pushes me away. Before I even get to react, a heavy shell strikes upon the building directly, tearing down the ceiling in an instant.

spans.text: Sangoma pushes me away. Before I even get to react, a heavy shell strikes upon the building directly, tearing down the ceiling in an instant.

units.rawText: The sachet's rope snaps, sending its herbs scattering through the air before falling to the ground. The delicate scent of lilac is swallowed by the acrid smoke and dust.
units.displayText: The sachet's rope snaps, sending its herbs scattering through the air before falling to the ground. The delicate scent of lilac is swallowed by the acrid smoke and dust.

spans.text: The sachet's rope snaps, sending its herbs scattering through the air before falling to the ground. The delicate scent of lilac is swallowed by the acrid smoke and dust.

units.rawText: As the stone shards from the building torn asunder rain upon us, my vision blacks out...
units.displayText: As the stone shards from the building torn asunder rain upon us, my vision blacks out...

spans.text: As the stone shards from the building torn asunder rain upon us, my vision blacks out...

units.rawText: When I regain consciousness, the Doll who pushed me away is crushed under a colossal stone, dark red operands spilling out and staining the scattered shards like blood.
units.displayText: When I regain consciousness, the Doll who pushed me away is crushed under a colossal stone, dark red operands spilling out and staining the scattered shards like blood.

spans.text: When I regain consciousness, the Doll who pushed me away is crushed under a colossal stone, dark red operands spilling out and staining the scattered shards like blood.

units.rawText: Sangoma! Sangoma!
units.displayText: Sangoma! Sangoma!

spans.text: Sangoma! Sangoma!

units.rawText: Let me use your scythe for now!
units.displayText: Let me use your scythe for now!

spans.text: Let me use your scythe for now!

units.rawText: One! Two!
units.displayText: One! Two!

spans.text: One! Two!

units.rawText: I use her scythe as a lever, doing my best to lift the stone from the purple-haired Doll.
units.displayText: I use her scythe as a lever, doing my best to lift the stone from the purple-haired Doll.

spans.text: I use her scythe as a lever, doing my best to lift the stone from the purple-haired Doll.

units.rawText: Sangoma! Sangoma! Sangoma, please wake up!
units.displayText: Sangoma! Sangoma! Sangoma, please wake up!

spans.text: Sangoma! Sangoma! Sangoma, please wake up!

units.rawText: Hng... Professor?
units.displayText: Hng... Professor?

spans.text: Hng... Professor?

units.rawText: Yes! It's me! I'm here!
units.displayText: Yes! It's me! I'm here!

spans.text: Yes! It's me! I'm here!

units.rawText: She softly touches my hand with a relieved smile on her face.
units.displayText: She softly touches my hand with a relieved smile on her face.

spans.text: She softly touches my hand with a relieved smile on her face.

units.rawText: Great. You're fine...
units.displayText: Great. You're fine...

spans.text: Great. You're fine...

units.rawText: Pay attention to yourself first in this kind of situation.
units.displayText: Pay attention to yourself first in this kind of situation.

spans.text: Pay attention to yourself first in this kind of situation.

units.rawText: The parts of her laid under the rock are severely damaged, covered by a shockingly large surface of blood-red stains with scorched fragments; her frame is fractured beyond comprehension.
units.displayText: The parts of her laid under the rock are severely damaged, covered by a shockingly large surface of blood-red stains with scorched fragments; her frame is fractured beyond comprehension.

spans.text: The parts of her laid under the rock are severely damaged, covered by a shockingly large surface of blood-red stains with scorched fragments; her frame is fractured beyond comprehension.

units.rawText: ...I will.
units.displayText: ...I will.

spans.text: ...I will.

units.rawText: At least... I protected you.
units.displayText: At least... I protected you.

spans.text: At least... I protected you.

units.rawText: How's the Oasis? The core system in the HQ...
units.displayText: How's the Oasis? The core system in the HQ...

spans.text: How's the Oasis? The core system in the HQ...

units.rawText: She struggles to feet, shifting the topic from herself to the Oasis.
units.displayText: She struggles to feet, shifting the topic from herself to the Oasis.

spans.text: She struggles to feet, shifting the topic from herself to the Oasis.

units.rawText: The screen shows only the pitch black of nothingness. Not a smidgen of information lay in my sight.
units.displayText: The screen shows only the pitch black of nothingness. Not a smidgen of information lay in my sight.

spans.text: The screen shows only the pitch black of nothingness. Not a smidgen of information lay in my sight.

units.rawText: All core systems, including defense and combat systems, are offline. We're too late.
units.displayText: All core systems, including defense and combat systems, are offline. We're too late.

spans.text: All core systems, including defense and combat systems, are offline. We're too late.

units.rawText: Even the communication system is down. I can't make contact with Persicaria, and I have no way to know what's happening in other areas.
units.displayText: Even the communication system is down. I can't make contact with Persicaria, and I have no way to know what's happening in other areas.

spans.text: Even the communication system is down. I can't make contact with Persicaria, and I have no way to know what's happening in other areas.

units.rawText: Though in truth, the escalating tremors shaking the HQ, coupled with the constant gunfire outside give us the bleak answer to that question.
units.displayText: Though in truth, the escalating tremors shaking the HQ, coupled with the constant gunfire outside give us the bleak answer to that question.

spans.text: Though in truth, the escalating tremors shaking the HQ, coupled with the constant gunfire outside give us the bleak answer to that question.

units.rawText: <cmdr>...
Staying here is too dangerous. I know it's hard to admit defeat, but now we must find a way to locate the survivors and call for a retreat...
units.displayText: Staying here is too dangerous. I know it's hard to admit defeat, but now we must find a way to locate the survivors and call for a retreat...

spans.text: Staying here is too dangerous. I know it's hard to admit defeat, but now we must find a way to locate the survivors and call for a retreat...

units.rawText: Not yet... There's a last resort.
units.displayText: Not yet... There's a last resort.

spans.text: Not yet... There's a last resort.

units.rawText: Last... resort?
units.displayText: Last... resort?

spans.text: Last... resort?

units.rawText: My voice feels unnaturally calm in the chaos around us.
units.displayText: My voice feels unnaturally calm in the chaos around us.

spans.text: My voice feels unnaturally calm in the chaos around us.

units.rawText: I'll connect to the Oasis' system using my neural cloud, force-activating the combat and defense modules.
units.displayText: I'll connect to the Oasis' system using my neural cloud, force-activating the combat and defense modules.

spans.text: I'll connect to the Oasis' system using my neural cloud, force-activating the combat and defense modules.

units.rawText: We don't have much time. Sangoma, can you help me?
units.displayText: We don't have much time. Sangoma, can you help me?

spans.text: We don't have much time. Sangoma, can you help me?

units.rawText: Are you out of your mind, <cmdr>?! There's no way your neural cloud can withstand the immense data flow of the entire Oasis!
units.displayText: Are you out of your mind, {교수}?! There's no way your neural cloud can withstand the immense data flow of the entire Oasis!

spans.text: Are you out of your mind,
?! There's no way your neural cloud can withstand the immense data flow of the entire Oasis!

units.rawText: Your consciousness will be instantly torn to shreds by the overwhelming stream of data as you connect to the system. You'll be lost forever between 1s and 0s, never to find the activation key you seek.
units.displayText: Your consciousness will be instantly torn to shreds by the overwhelming stream of data as you connect to the system. You'll be lost forever between 1s and 0s, never to find the activation key you seek.

spans.text: Your consciousness will be instantly torn to shreds by the overwhelming stream of data as you connect to the system. You'll be lost forever between 1s and 0s, never to find the activation key you seek.

units.rawText: We may be in a desperate time, but it doesn't call for such desperate measures!
units.displayText: We may be in a desperate time, but it doesn't call for such desperate measures!

spans.text: We may be in a desperate time, but it doesn't call for such desperate measures!

units.rawText: I'm a human. My neural cloud holds a greater capacity than standard Dolls. There is a slim chance.
units.displayText: I'm a human. My neural cloud holds a greater capacity than standard Dolls. There is a slim chance.

spans.text: I'm a human. My neural cloud holds a greater capacity than standard Dolls. There is a slim chance.

units.rawText: Even if it means your neural cloud will burn out and you'll never wake again?
units.displayText: Even if it means your neural cloud will burn out and you'll never wake again?

spans.text: Even if it means your neural cloud will burn out and you'll never wake again?

units.rawText: ...Even then, it's the path I must take.
units.displayText: ...Even then, it's the path I must take.

spans.text: ...Even then, it's the path I must take.

units.rawText: If I succeed, the Oasis will have a chance to live.
units.displayText: If I succeed, the Oasis will have a chance to live.

spans.text: If I succeed, the Oasis will have a chance to live.

units.rawText: I turn my head to the screen, the face showing on the shattered glass both familiar and strange.
units.displayText: I turn my head to the screen, the face showing on the shattered glass both familiar and strange.

spans.text: I turn my head to the screen, the face showing on the shattered glass both familiar and strange.

units.rawText: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.
units.displayText: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.

spans.text: After all... I'm everyone's Professor.
